Join a tiny hero on a very big journey. Moss: The Forgotten Relic launches July 16, 2026 on PlayStation 5. 

In Moss: The Forgotten Relic, guide a tiny hero who can see you, and needs your help through a heartfelt journey filled with challenge, courage, and connection. Journey through the living pages of a legend in the making in a storybook world filled with forgotten ruins, ancient magic, and towering dangers.  

Moss: The Forgotten Relic is a reimagined collection that brings Moss, Moss: Book II, and the Twilight Garden expansion together into one handcrafted fantasy adventure for PlayStation 5, without the requirement of a VR headset.

The expedition begins today. The Mound: Omen of Cthulhu is officially out now!

Assemble your crew and descend into a shifting, cursed jungle where your own mind is the ultimate enemy. In this 4-player co-op Lovecraftian horror game, you must hunt for legendary treasures, and survive as madness quietly distorts your reality. With no UI indicators to warn you, you will have to rely entirely on your teammates to know what is real - and what is just a trick of your unraveling mind. Play now on PlayStation 5.
